why: Restores the exact array this replaced, character for character, as it stood before issue #912 -- every pane named by hand and `alertView` missing from the end. This is not a hypothetical regression: it is the code that shipped, and it left the match-failure overlay operable by pointer and Tab only, so a pad player who hit a failed match could dismiss it and never choose Retry. It is the most important entry here because it is the one a well-meaning refactor would reintroduce, and the list looks complete.
killedBy: every HUD layer is reachable by arrows and by a D-pad (issue #914) gives the pad the keyboard inside match-failed
